Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients with evidence for severe insulin resistance or a disorder associated with severe insulin resistance must meet all of the following criteria: Suspected severe insulin resistance, or a disorder associated with severe insulin resistance, as evidenced by one or more of the following: Hyperinsulinemia (i.e. fasting insulin >30microU/mL)
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has type 2 diabetes with HbA1c 6.5-7.2% but no data on fasting insulin levels or hyperinsulinemia. No mention of insulin requirement >2 units/kg/day or >200 units/day.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Phenotypic features suggesting a defect in glucose/lipid metabolism: Acanthosis nigricans, Lipodystrophy/abnormal fat distribution, Xanthomata, Fatty liver
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of acanthosis nigricans, lipodystrophy, xanthomata, or fatty liver in the patient's description.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Known or suspected mutations of the insulin receptor gene
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has an LDLR c.1444G>A mutation (familial hypercholesterolemia), not an insulin receptor gene mutation.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Known or suspected autoantibodies to the insulin receptor
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of insulin receptor autoantibodies in the patient's description.
Patient is 58 years old, which satisfies the age requirement.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Ability of subject or Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) to understand and the willingness to sign a written informed consent document
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Written informed consent has been obtained from the patient or their legal representative.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Biological relatives of patients in category (1) in whom a genetic cause of insulin resistance is known or suspected
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is not a family member of another participant; this criterion applies to family members, not the patient himself.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy control subjects Cohort 1: In good general health with no known active medical conditions as evidenced by medical history
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has active medical conditions including type 2 diabetes, hypercholesterolemia, coronary artery disease, and history of myocardial infarctions.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy control subjects Cohort 2: Fasting glucose <100 mg/dL
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has type 2 diabetes with HbA1c 6.5-7.2%, indicating impaired glucose control, but fasting glucose is not explicitly stated. However, diabetes diagnosis implies fasting glucose ≥126 mg/dL.
Patient's HbA1c ranges between 6.5% and 7.2%, which exceeds the 5.7% threshold.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Family members of patients, above: Pregnant at the time of enrollment
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is not a family member of another participant; this criterion applies to family members, not the patient himself.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy control subjects Cohort 1: Current use of prescription or non-prescription medication (except topical medications, vitamins, hormonal contraceptives)
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is currently on metformin, a prescription medication, which is not exempted under the exceptions listed.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy control subjects Cohort 1: Recent (past 2 months) use of drugs or supplements that alter glucose or lipid metabolism
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No information is provided about recent use of drugs or supplements affecting glucose/lipid metabolism.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy control subjects Cohort 1: History of diabetes or abnormal glucose tolerance
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has a documented history of type 2 diabetes.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy control subjects Cohort 2: Abnormal screening labs, including ALT or AST more than 1.5 times the upper limit of normal
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has mild elevation of hepatic transaminases but no specific values are provided to determine if they exceed 1.5x ULN.
No mention of glycosuria in the patient's description.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy control subjects Cohort 2: Clinically significant anemia
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of anemia in the patient's description.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Healthy control subjects Cohort 2: Low eGFR (<60 mL/min/1.73m2)
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No information is provided about the patient's eGFR.

Recap: Patient does not meet inclusion criteria for any group (no evidence of severe insulin resistance, not a family member of a patient with insulin resistance, and not a healthy control due to active diabetes and other comorbidities). Exclusion criteria are violated for Cohort 1 (current use of metformin and history of diabetes).
